The Top 20 contestants will continue to perform during the Disney’s Aulani Resort round for the episode airing on Monday, March 23 on ABC. Audiences now have a say in the competition, with voting happening on AmericanIdol.com/vote, through SMS text, or via social media commenting. The results of the voting from last week and this week will be announced during the live show on March 30.
